title: Rate Lock Commitment Requirements for Taking Each Lock Term
content:
Each **Rate Lock Commitment** product can be taken only on a loan file that meets that product's requirements. The table states, for every product, the loan file statuses in which the lock may be requested, the loan purposes it may protect, whether the property must be a new-construction purchase from a builder, the minimum representative credit score on the file, and the maximum base-loan-to-value on the file.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Loan file statuses in which the lock may be requested | Loan purposes the lock may protect | New-construction purchase from a builder required | Minimum representative credit score | Maximum base-loan-to-value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | conditionally approved; clear to close | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | No | 580 | 100.00% |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | application received; disclosed; processing; underwriting; conditionally approved; clear to close | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | No | 580 | 100.00% |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | application received; disclosed; processing; underwriting; conditionally approved; clear to close | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | No | 580 | 100.00% |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | application received; disclosed; processing; underwriting; conditionally approved; clear to close | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | No | 580 | 100.00% |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | application received; disclosed; processing; underwriting; conditionally approved; clear to close | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | No | 620 | 97.00% |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | processing; underwriting; conditionally approved; clear to close | purchase | No | 680 | 95.00% |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | processing; underwriting; conditionally approved; clear to close | purchase | Yes | 680 | 95.00% |

### Notes on the table

- The credit score threshold is a minimum: a file at exactly 580 meets it for the 15-, 30-, 45- and 60-day locks, and a file at 579 does not.
- The loan-to-value figure is a maximum: a file at exactly 97.00% meets it for the Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock, and a file at 97.01% does not.
- Only the Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock requires the subject property to be a new-construction purchase from a builder; the Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock and the Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock protect purchases only.
- The Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock can be requested only on a file that is conditionally approved or clear to close.
